notes: Wiener Linien 24-hour pass 10 EUR, 7-day pass about 25 EUR (48/72-hour passes discontinued); CAT or S7 to the airport. The city is walkable; take a tram for a Ring tour or two.
Schönbrunn and Belvedere have timed online tickets; opera standing tickets are sold at the box office 80 minutes before (opera closed in summer).
Christmas markets in November and December (Rathaus, Schönbrunn, Spittelberg) and ball season in January and February; winter is 0-5°C and coffeehouses are at their best.
Schnitzel 20-25 EUR (Figlmüller); in a coffeehouse a Melange is 5 EUR and cake 6 EUR; Sturm at a heuriger in autumn. Tip 5-10%.
Shops are closed on Sundays; museums are open.
For the Wachau, use the ÖBB combination ticket; apricot blossom in April, wine harvest in September and October.

stops.name: Stephansdom
stops.tips: Cathedral with a colourful tiled roof; the south tower is 343 steps (6 EUR). Quiet in the morning.

stops.name: Graben & Kohlmarkt
stops.tips: The Plague Column and Demel's shop window; imperial-era streets.

stops.name: Hofburg Sisi Museum
stops.tips: Imperial apartments, the Sisi Museum and the silver collection; audio guide included.

stops.name: Café Central
stops.tips: Vienna coffeehouse with columns; try the Apfelstrudel and a Melange. The queue is about 15 minutes.

stops.name: Wiener Staatsoper
stops.tips: Standing tickets (Stehplatz) go on sale 80 minutes before the show for 13-18 EUR. The opera season runs September to June; closed in summer.

backups.name: Albertina
backups.tips: Dürer's Hare and works from Monet to Picasso; an alternative to the Hofburg.

stops.name: Schönbrunn Palace
stops.tips: The Habsburgs' summer palace; Imperial Tour 22 EUR online, first slot 08:30, includes the Hall of Mirrors.

stops.name: Schönbrunn Gloriette
stops.tips: Walk up the hill through the gardens; coffee at the Gloriette café with a view of the palace.

stops.name: Schönbrunn Zoo
stops.tips: The world's oldest zoo (1752); pandas.

stops.name: Landtmann's Parkcafé Schönbrunn
stops.tips: Café in the palace park; schnitzel and cake.

stops.name: Naschmarkt
stops.tips: A 1.5 km market with Turkish and Balkan stalls, fish at Umar, and a flea market on Saturdays.

backups.name: Neni am Naschmarkt
backups.tips: Tel Aviv cuisine, inside the market.

backups.name: Wagenburg Schönbrunn
backups.tips: Museum of imperial carriages; an alternative to the zoo.

stops.name: Upper Belvedere
stops.tips: Klimt's The Kiss and Schiele; a Baroque palace. Book online.

stops.name: Belvedere Gardens
stops.tips: Gardens between the two palaces; sphinxes.

stops.name: Karlskirche
stops.tips: Baroque dome; take the lift up to the fresco level.

stops.name: Figlmüller Wollzeile
stops.tips: Schnitzel (pork) that spills off the plate, served since 1905. Book ahead; the Bäckerstrasse branch is quieter.

stops.name: Kunsthistorisches Museum
stops.tips: Bruegel collection, Vermeer and a café under the dome; on Maria-Theresien-Platz.

backups.name: Gasthaus Pöschl
backups.tips: Local schnitzel and tafelspitz (boiled beef); a fallback if Figlmüller is full.

backups.name: Secession
backups.tips: Klimt's Beethoven Frieze; the golden cabbage dome.

stops.name: Wiener Riesenrad
stops.tips: Ferris wheel from 1897; the setting of The Third Man. No queue in the morning.

stops.name: Prater Hauptallee
stops.tips: A 4 km chestnut-lined avenue; cycling and the Lusthaus.

stops.name: Schweizerhaus Prater
stops.tips: Closed in winter; go to Prater Alm or the Lusthaus instead.

stops.name: Donauinsel
stops.tips: A winter walk; river birds.

stops.name: Hundertwasserhaus
stops.tips: Colourful apartment block with wavy floors; seen from outside. The Kunst Haus Wien museum is nearby.

backups.name: Lusthaus Prater
backups.tips: Historic pavilion restaurant at the end of the park.

backups.name: Alte Donau Boat
backups.tips: Pedal boat on the Old Danube; an alternative to the island.

stops.name: Melk Abbey
stops.tips: 1 hour by train; Baroque abbey and library with Danube views. Use the ÖBB Wachau combination ticket (train, boat and abbey).

stops.name: Melk-Krems Danube Boat
stops.tips: 2 hours along the valley; vineyards and castles (Dürnstein).

stops.name: Dürnstein
stops.tips: Town with a blue tower; climb to the castle where Richard the Lionheart was held.

stops.name: Dürnstein Heuriger
stops.tips: Grüner Veltliner and apricot products at a wine tavern; Wachau apricots.

stops.name: Krems Steiner Tor
stops.tips: The old town gate of Krems; return train at 17:00.

backups.name: Loibnerhof Unterloiben
backups.tips: Famous Wachau restaurant, next to Dürnstein.

backups.name: Weissenkirchen
backups.tips: Wine village; stop here by boat instead of Krems.

stops.name: MuseumsQuartier
stops.tips: Leopold Museum (Schiele) and the courtyard seating; mumok.

stops.name: Spittelberg
stops.tips: Biedermeier streets; Christmas market in December.

stops.name: Glacis Beisl Spittelberg
stops.tips: Beisl (Viennese tavern) with a garden behind the MQ; Viennese home cooking.

stops.name: Grinzing Heuriger Mayer am Pfarrplatz
stops.tips: Wine tavern in Beethoven's former home; take bus 38A. Try the Sturm (September) and Liptauer.

stops.name: Kahlenberg
stops.tips: City and Danube views from the top of the Vienna Woods; take the 38A, go at sunset.

backups.name: Heuriger Sirbu
backups.tips: Wine tavern with views among the Nussberg vineyards; May to October.

backups.name: Karl-Marx-Hof
backups.tips: Red Vienna's 1 km-long housing block; Heiligenstadt.

stops.name: Café Sperl
stops.tips: Coffeehouse from 1880; billiard tables and newspapers, ideal for a farewell breakfast.

stops.name: Mariahilfer Strasse
stops.tips: Shopping street; souvenirs (Manner wafers).

stops.name: Imperial Treasury Vienna
stops.tips: The Habsburg crown and the Holy Lance; Hofburg.

stops.name: Wien Hauptbahnhof CAT
stops.tips: City Airport Train takes 16 minutes (or S7, 30 minutes); farewell.

backups.name: Demel
backups.tips: The Hofburg's pastry shop; Sacher's rival.

backups.name: Haus der Musik
backups.tips: Sound museum; conduct the Philharmonic virtually.
